VBO:0201221.summary: Affectionate with people he knew well, Tinky was a Shih Tzu–Chihuahua cross who liked a quiet life and a warm bed, according to the ASPCA. He paused to take in the scenery on walks and needed time to warm to new people. The rescue described him as bonded to his best friend Sophie.
VBO:0201221.shortDescription: The ASPCA described Tinky, a ShiChi, as affectionate with familiar people, fond of a warm bed and unhurried walks.
